senses.gloss:
लोभ, अस्, m. eager desire or wish, covetousness,
cupidity, avarice, greediness, greed; Avarice perso-
nified (as a son of Puṣṭi or of Dambha and Māyā);
desire for or after (with gen. or at the end of a
comp.).
—लोभ-मञ्जरी, f. the pearl of covetous-
ness.
—लोभ-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, beguiled by covet-
ousness, infatuated through avarice.
—लोभ-विरह,
अस्, m. absence of avarice; (अस्, आ, अम्), free from
cupidity.
—लोभाकृष्ट (˚भ-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
attracted by greediness, tempted by covetousness.
—लोभान्वित (˚भ-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, possessed of
covetousness, avaricious, greedy.
—लोभाभिपातिन्
(˚भ-अभ्˚), ई, इनी, इ, hastening through eager desire,
rushing greedily.
—लोभोत्कर्ष (˚भ-उत्˚), अस्, m.
excess of avarice, excessive greed or avarice.

लोभ लोभ, लोभिन्, लोभ्य. See p. 870,
col. 2.

लोभन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus.), alluring, en-
ticing, attracting, charming; (अम्), n. the act of
alluring, allurement, enticement, temptation; gold.

लोभनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be desired or longed
for, alluring, enticing, seductive, attractive.
—लोभ-
नीय-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most worthy of being de-
sired, most attractive.
—लोभनीयतमाकृति (˚म-
आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, having a most attractive figure.
लोभयान, अस्, आ, अम्, alluring, enticing, seducing.
लोभयित्वा, ind. having allured or enticed.

लोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, allured, enticed, seduced.
—लोभित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has allured,
&c.

लोभिन्, ई, इनी, इ, desirous, greedy, covetous, ava-
ricious, longing for, eager after, desirous of (often at
the end of comps., e. g. धन-लोभिन्, desirous of
wealth); alluring, enticing, attracting.

लोभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be eagerly desired, desir-
able, alluring, enticing, attractive; (अस्), m. Phaseolus
Mungo.
लोभ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being allured or enticed.
